transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling really anxious and scared lately. For over two years, I've had this constant feeling that I'm being watched and targeted by people who want to harm me. It feels like they are monitoring everything I do, and I just don't know what to do anymore.

Besides these feelings of being watched, have you experienced any long periods where your mood was extremely high or low, or where your energy levels were significantly different from your normal self?
No, I haven't really experienced any extreme highs or lows in my mood. My energy levels have also been pretty normal and haven't changed much.

Beyond these concerns about being watched, have you noticed any changes in your ability to enjoy things, or have you found yourself feeling less motivated or more withdrawn from your friends and daily activities?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes in my motivation or how much I enjoy things. I still have the same desire to be around my friends as I always have.

Aside from the feeling of being watched, have you ever heard voices that others cannot hear, or experienced any other unusual sensations like seeing things or smelling odors that aren't actually there?

Yes, I hear whispering voices when no one is around, and sometimes I see dark, shadow-like figures moving in my room. I also frequently smell a strange, chemical odor that others tell me isn't there, and it all feels incredibly real and unsettling to me.

Do you ever find that your thoughts become jumbled or that you have difficulty speaking clearly to others, or have you ever felt that your own thoughts were being broadcasted out loud for others to hear?

Yes, I often find that my thoughts get really jumbled and I struggle to stay on track, which makes it hard for others to understand what I'm trying to say. However, I have never experienced my thoughts being broadcasted out loud for everyone to hear.

Has this persistent feeling of being watched or these experiences with voices and shadows significantly interfered with your ability to work, go to school, or handle your basic daily responsibilities?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about how all of this has affected my daily life or my responsibilities.
